- Fixed sign-in failing with "Blackboard could not be reached" on networks where the server rejected the app's secure connection; the app now uses Windows' own TLS.
- Longer sign-in and download timeouts, so slow browsers and slow connections can finish.
- Clear downloaded files now asks for confirmation before deleting anything, and the "Cleared" message disappears after a few seconds.
- The app now waits up to a minute for Blackboard to show the course list after signing in, instead of failing at once.
- The background animation starts right after launch, even when the window is not focused yet.
- Notices and error messages disappear after 3 seconds unless work is still in progress.
- You can now cancel while signing in or scanning courses, and exit from the course and file lists back to the start screen.
- The Headless / Visible switch glides smoothly instead of jumping.
